name: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking
old_description: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking specializes in handcrafted, heirloom quality furniture. about:
Whitehurst Custom Woodworking is based in Raleigh, North Carolina. The business grew from the founder's lifelong interest in making things, nurtured by a metalworking father in Tarboro. After a decade spent in other careers, the founder turned a woodworking hobby into a full-time venture, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces handcrafted, heirloom-quality furniture and end-grain butcher blocks using traditional joinery techniques and solid wood. Every piece is built to order with an emphasis on natural materials and functional, timeless design. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves homeowners and designers throughout the Raleigh–Durham–Chapel Hill triangle, delivering custom pieces such as dining tables, sewing stations, and other built‑in furniture tailored to individual spaces.

Its stated mission is to preserve the craft of fine furniture making by offering the community furniture built with exceptional craftsmanship that is rooted in tradition and embraces innovation. The founder emphasizes that "how it's made matters" as a guiding principle.
